WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    SUM(orders.amount) AS "orders.amount_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), _cm_orders__customers__score_max AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(customers.score) AS "customers.score_max"
  FROM customers AS customers
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.order_date",
    CAST(_base."orders.amount_sum" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / _cm_orders__customers__score_max."customers.score_max" AS "orders.a",
    _base."orders.amount_sum",
    _cm_orders__customers__score_max."customers.score_max" AS "customers.score_max"
  FROM _base
  CROSS JOIN _cm_orders__customers__score_max
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.amount_sum",
    "orders.a",
    "customers.score_max",

    "orders._cumsum_inner" > 9
